contextual_resolubility_validation.validation_summary: The temporal phrase 'within 2 s' has syntactic ambiguity regarding whether it constrains the informing action or the damage detection action. No context is available to resolve this scope ambiguity.

unsupported_interpretations: The system must inform the security service within 2 seconds after the damage has been detected (Time constraint on informing).
The system must detect the damage within 2 seconds, and then inform the security service (Time constraint on detection).
evidence_from_requirement: The phrase 'within 2 s after detecting damage' is present.
missing_information: It is unclear whether the time constraint applies to the 'inform' action or the 'detecting damage' action.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement text allows for two distinct interpretations of the temporal scope, and no context is provided to eliminate one.

overall_resolubility.explanation: The ambiguity regarding the scope of the time constraint (AMB-01) remains unresolved because the requirement text alone does not specify whether the 2-second limit applies to informing or detecting.
